messages:
tara-sales: Heads-up: BlueBridge procurement returned the MSA with DPA redlines and insists PO must be on file before signature. They want KMS BYOK + HSM language.
emma-legal: Quick summary pls: SLA ask? any audit windows changed?
mike-ps: They want 99.99% SLA and monthly audit access. Also request that invoices be issued on PO receipt (not countersignature).
finance-bot: finance-bot: we can accept PO for procurement (pro forma) but final invoice requires executed agreement. Net30 okay.
ops-team: We can add a PO field and a checkbox for "PO attached" in the order form. Conditional DocuSign routing possible.
emma-legal: I'll propose compromise: 99.95% for Dedicated with capped credits; BYOK/HSM for Dedicated immediately, Hosted on roadmap with 90-day commitment. Add DPA with SCCs and NDA for redacted pen test.
tara-sales: Great. Can legal send tracked redline by EOD? Customer wants to close this week.
emma-legal: I'll send redline + DPA + NDA by 6pm PT.
tara-sales: Thanks — I'll prepare the order form template with PO field and routing notes.
